title_en: District at a glance: what each district's own official books and pages say
title_te: జిల్లా ఒక చూపులో: ప్రతి జిల్లా సొంత ప్రభుత్వ పుస్తకాలు, పేజీలు ఏమి చెబుతున్నాయి
why_it_matters_en: People hear claims like 'our district has the most schools' or 'this many villages were left behind'. These are the counts each district's own Collectorate publishes, with the page you can open and check.
why_it_matters_te: 'మా జిల్లాలో ఎక్కువ బడులు ఉన్నాయి', 'ఇన్ని గ్రామాలు వెనుకబడ్డాయి' అని వింటుంటాం. ప్రతి జిల్లా కలెక్టరేట్ తానే ప్రచురించిన లెక్కలు ఇవి. పేజీ తెరిచి మీరే చూసుకోవచ్చు.

refresh.how: Each district site: https://<host>/documents/ and https://<host>/?s=handbook (S3WaaS search); for the newest example see https://spsnellore.ap.gov.in/document/district-handbook-of-statistics-2025/. Re-run scratchpad/gather/district_sites/survey.py and doclist.py per host, then parse_compare.py, mapper.py, verify_geom.py.
refresh.cadence: Irregular. Most sites have not posted a new handbook since April and May 2022; Nellore posts yearly.
refresh.notes: PDFs only. WordPress REST API is closed (401). Some PDFs are scanned images (Palnadu).

checks.how: requests GET of https://<host>/ for every district, retried after relay resets; page titles confirm each district.

checks.how: 28 PDFs downloaded twice (raw/pdf and raw/pdf_v2); sha256 equal for all 28.

checks.what: Every comparison-table value re-read by a second, independent method
checks.how: pdfplumber word positions on the second download; row state and district cells must equal the pdftotext reading. 1815 of 1816 values matched; the 1 mismatch is the Visakhapatnam municipal corporation row, confirmed on the rendered page image (district cell blank) and recorded as blank.

checks.what: Row to series mapping checked across books
checks.how: Matrix of every series against all 15 text books reviewed by eye; no duplicate series per book; 0 unmapped rows.

checks.what: Suspicious values checked on page images
checks.how: Rendered Kurnool p16, Bapatla p17, Visakhapatnam p26 at 70 to 80 dpi and read them; values are as printed (see source_flags).
Read at 100 dpi, then cropped item and district columns at 130 dpi from the second download and read again; all 87 values agree. Area and population rows also match the Palnadu Demography web page.
Fresh fetch of each web page and second-download text of the two profile PDFs; 98 of 98 printed strings found next to their label.

checks.what: Every document URL in inventory.json opens
checks.how: HTTP HEAD on 83 document URLs: all 200.
Only district totals. Who's Who, officer lists, FIR lists, land acquisition notices and voter lists were not read into the data.
Units kept as printed per point (unit_printed). No conversion.

source_flags: Bapatla handbook, Table B (PDF p17): the five 'Child Population (0-6)' rows print the same numbers as total population (15.87, 7.89, 7.98, 13.03, 2.84 lakh). Kept as printed.
Kurnool handbook 2021, Table B (PDF p16): birth rate rural 7.25 and urban 41.80 against total 16.69 per 1000. Kept as printed.
Visakhapatnam handbook, Table B (PDF p26): 'Municipal Corporations' district cell is blank; the State cell prints 161 (other books print 16 or 17). Recorded as blank.
YSR Kadapa handbook, Table B (PDF p24): sex ratio printed as 9.82. Kept as printed.
SPS Nellore handbook 2025, Table B (PDF p20): net cropped area 222.47 is printed larger than gross cropped area 220.69 ('000 ha); the State column has the same problem (5913.67 against 5716.74).

Krishna handbook (cover says DRAFT), Table B: child population printed 30.20 lakh while total population is 17.35 lakh (PDF p14); gross cropped area printed 3.76 under the unit '000 hectares (PDF p15).
Annamayya handbook, Table B (PDF p24): primary health centres printed as 4. Kept as printed.
Many handbooks print the unit 'In Lakhs' for the row '% of Rural Population to Total Population'. The value is a percentage.
Birth, death and infant death rates are labelled 'United A.P.' SRS 2018. ASR, Anakapalli and Visakhapatnam print identical figures, so they are the old district's figures, not the new districts'.
Palnadu handbook 2024 tables are headed 'Narasaraopet District' and print 2 revenue divisions.
East Godavari Demography page prints 22 revenue mandals in the table and 19 mandals in the sentence above it.
Konaseema Demography page prints 2 revenue divisions; its Revenue Division page says 3.
gaps: No District Hand Book of Statistics is posted on the sites of 12 districts: Chittoor, Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Konaseema, East Godavari, Eluru, Guntur, Kakinada, Markapuram, NTR, Polavaram, Srikakulam, Tirupati, West Godavari. For 11 of them the site_* series carry what their web pages or profile PDFs print. Polavaram has no figures of its own yet.
Polavaram district (from 1 Jan 2026): the website is template text and copies Alluri Sitharama Raju figures. No value recorded.
Markapuram district (from 1 Jan 2026): only admin counts and area on its Demography page; no population or handbook.

Almost all handbooks carry 2019-20 data and the 26-district map (published April and May 2022). Only SPS Nellore has a 2025 edition (2024-25 data) and Palnadu a 2024 edition (2021-22 comparison table). Kurnool is 2020-21. No handbook on any site uses the 28-district map.

Older editions (2014-15 onward, 13-district map) are on only two sites: Vizianagaram (2018, 2019) and SPS Nellore (2018, 2019-20, 2022, 2023, 2024). They were catalogued in inventory.json but not extracted.
Banks and road length are not in the comparison table; they sit in detailed handbook tables (14.3 bank branches, 13.1 road length) and were not extracted in this run.
Palnadu: production of rice to sunflower (PDF p21) and student enrolment (PDF p24) were not read from the scanned pages.
District courts on districts.ecourts.gov.in reset every connection from here; not checked.
No data dashboards are published on any district site.
Zilla Parishad and DCCB websites were not found or not verified per district.
The Krishna 2019-20 handbook for the undivided district (13 map) was parsed and verified but kept out of dataset.json; its file is listed in inventory.json.
